title: FizzBuzz
description: Write a function that takes a number n and returns 'Fizz' if it is divisible by 3, 'Buzz' if divisible by 5, 'FizzBuzz' if divisible by both, and the number itself as a string if none of those apply.
instructions: Complete the fizzbuzz function so it returns the correct string for any positive integer.
hints: Check divisibility using the modulo operator: n % 3 == 0 means n is divisible by 3.
Make sure you check for FizzBuzz (divisible by both) before checking Fizz or Buzz alone.
To return the number as a string, use str(n).
